start: sh -c 'cd /app && bunx prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma 2>/dev/null; bunx prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss 2>/dev/null; export API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001; cd apps/api && node dist/main.js & API_PID=$!; echo "Waiting for API..."; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "API ready!" && break; sleep 1; done; cd /app/apps/web && bun x next start -H 0.0.0.0'
